def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    d = d.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # normalize island labels (extra spaces / variants)
    d['island'] = d['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    d.loc[~d['island'].isin(['Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen']), 'island'] = pd.NA
    # normalize species
    d['species'] = d['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # flipper_length_mm: parse text, fix invalid negative / out-of-range values
    d['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(d['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    d.loc[(d['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (d['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # body_mass_g: parse text numbers (commas), flag out-of-range as invalid
    d['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        d['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    d.loc[(d['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (d['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # bill_length_mm range check
    d['bill_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(d['bill_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    d.loc[(d['bill_length_mm'] < 30) | (d['bill_length_mm'] > 60), 'bill_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    adelie = d[d['species'] == 'Adelie'].copy()
    adelie = adelie.dropna(subset=['island', 'bill_length_mm'])
    means = adelie.groupby('island')['bill_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in means.items()}
